description: The LCS DP table can be viewed as a 2D tensor network where each cell is a local tensor encoding the recurrence. Techniques from quantum information (MPS, DMRG) can contract such networks approximately, enabling computation of E[LCS] for much larger n than exact methods allow.
mathematical_formalization: Define local tensor T^{(i,j)} at grid point (i,j) encoding the max-plus recurrence. Full LCS = contraction of all tensors. Approximate via MPS of bond dimension chi. Error is O(exp(-c*chi)).
implementation_hypothesis: Encode LCS DP as 2D tensor network. Use boundary MPS method. For each random string pair, contract with chi=32,64,128. Average over many instances.
experiment_seed: Implement tensor network for n=50 binary LCS. Contract using ITensor with chi=32. Average over 1000 random pairs. Compare E[LCS]/n with known values.
